P1-08.P1_flat: - Working values. Partial results inside a computation (a partial sum, product or round value, a debiasing step with its state and flag, although step 2 would call them a decision) are part of the result they produce (step 3), not concepts of their own. Judged as usual: the finished result, even an instance output, held where computed or an output port takes it from; a count. Do not name a synchronizer stage (a register only shifting in one unit input port's bit, apart from constants) in any concept's information or cite its lines as held lines.
P1-08.P1_structured:
- Working values (a).
  Scope: inside a computation.
  Criteria (any of): (1) a partial sum, product or round value; (2) a debiasing step with its state and flag, although step 2 would call them a decision.
  Exceptions: judged as usual: the finished result, even an instance output, held where computed or an output port takes it from; a count.
  Outcome: partial results are part of the result they produce (step 3), not concepts of their own.
- Working values (b).
  Scope: a synchronizer stage.
  Criteria: a register only shifting in one unit input port's bit, apart from constants.
  Outcome: do not name it in any concept's information or cite its lines as held lines.
P1-08.P2_flat: Partial results of a computation of this unit belong to its result and never qualify for any conceptual asset: a partial sum or product, an addend, a subtraction step or round value, a value before the final sign step, a value computed only to be copied, whole or in part, into the finished result's register, a compare only picking that result (a minimum or maximum), and a debiasing step with its state and flag. Judged as usual: the element holding the finished result or that an output port takes it from, even while holding operand copies or partial values; a unit port; a signal taking an instance output whole or handing the finished result whole to an instance; a count; a setting that changes how operands are read (signedness); a serial port's data shift register and a one-bit register feeding it; and any other decision (such as a compare whose result picks or triggers what happens next, or checks combined per region or entry). A synchronizer stage is not primary for any conceptual asset: a register whose assignments, apart from constants, only copy in one unit input port's bit (directly or through a wire or type conversion only copying it) and shift its own earlier bits along; a wire only copying one of its bits is part of it. Judged as usual: the port itself; a register copying a port with none of its own earlier bits (an input register software reads back); a shift register assembling a received word from a stage's bits; and an element mixing the port or a stage's bits with other values (a request held until served, a sticky flag).
P1-08.P2_structured:
- Working values (a).
  Scope: a computation of this unit.
  Criteria (any of): (1) a partial sum or product, an addend, a subtraction step or round value; (2) a value before the final sign step; (3) a value computed only to be copied, whole or in part, into the finished result's register; (4) a compare only picking that result (a minimum or maximum); (5) a debiasing step with its state and flag.
  Exceptions: judged as usual: the element holding the finished result or that an output port takes it from, even while holding operand copies or partial values; a unit port; a signal taking an instance output whole or handing the finished result whole to an instance; a count; a setting that changes how operands are read (signedness); a serial port's data shift register and a one-bit register feeding it; and any other decision (such as a compare whose result picks or triggers what happens next, or checks combined per region or entry).
  Outcome: partial results belong to the computation's result and never qualify for any conceptual asset.
- Working values (b).
  Scope: a synchronizer stage; a wire only copying one of its bits is part of it.
  Criteria: a register whose assignments, apart from constants, only (1) copy in one unit input port's bit (directly or through a wire or type conversion only copying it) and (2) shift its own earlier bits along.
  Exceptions: judged as usual: the port itself; a register copying a port with none of its own earlier bits (an input register software reads back); a shift register assembling a received word from a stage's bits; and an element mixing the port or a stage's bits with other values (a request held until served, a sticky flag).
  Outcome: it is not primary for any conceptual asset.

P1-09.P1_flat: - Slices. A signal (not a port) whose every value, apart from reset and another generate branch's constants, is one element's slices or indexed bits, alone or joined, even through signals, only carries that element's value (2.2), unless that element is a bus request or response record port, a field of one, or a write's data: such a slice is judged as usual (2.6). Otherwise it is not a piece of its own: do not cite its lines as held lines.
P1-09.P1_structured:
- Slices.
  Scope: a signal (not a port).
  Criteria: whose every value, apart from reset and another generate branch's constants, is one element's slices or indexed bits, alone or joined, even through signals.
  Exceptions: that element is a bus request or response record port, a field of one, or a write's data: such a slice is judged as usual (2.6).
  Outcome: it only carries that element's value (2.2) and is not a piece of its own: do not cite its lines as held lines.
P1-09.P2_flat: A signal (not a port) whose every value, apart from reset and another generate branch's constants, is one element's slices or indexed bits, alone or joined, even through signals, only carries that element's value (2.2), unless that element is a bus request or response record port, a field of one, or a write's data: such a slice is judged as usual (2.6). Otherwise it never qualifies as primary for any conceptual asset: the element it takes from keeps its own label, and the signal can be a secondary (2.7, direction a).
